title: Victoria Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Victoria Run Review: GBK Jakarta, Heat, Cut-offs, Prize Rules
meta_description: Victoria Run review: the 2025 race at GBK Senayan drew about 8,000 runners, with 25°C and 89% humidity at 5am and 31°C by 9am. The 2026 start times, cut-offs, fees and prize rules.
dek: What Bank Victoria's Jakarta race was like in its first year at Gelora Bung Karno, in 2025: the size of the field, the morning heat and the finish-line party, plus the start times, cut-offs and rules published for 2026.
verdict: Enter if you want a big, festive race in central Jakarta with a concert at the finish, and you are running for the experience rather than a time. The 2025 edition, the first at Gelora Bung Karno, drew about 8,000 runners by the organiser's count over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The catch is the heat and the lack of detail. At 5am it was 25°C with 89% humidity and no wind, and by 9am it was 31°C. No 2025 route or results are on the race website, and the 2026 route was still to be announced. Pace the half for a hot finish, and note that only Indonesian citizens can win prize money.

sections.heading: The 2025 Race: A Bank's Anniversary Run Moves to Senayan
paragraphs: Victoria Run 2025 was held on Sunday 12 October at Gelora Bung Karno in Senayan, central Jakarta, to mark Bank Victoria's 31st anniversary [1]. It had been held at Q-Big BSD in South Tangerang for the previous two years; the bank said it moved to GBK to bring the race closer to the city's running community and to fit a bigger event [1][2]. The race was based in the east car park, Parkir Timur, and was put on by the bank with the Jakarta provincial government [3].

There were three distances: 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [1]. The 2024 race had added a 30 km for the bank's 30th anniversary; that was dropped for 2025 because, the event director said, the organiser wants the race known for its half marathon [2]. The race has been held since 2022 [2].

The event director put participation at 8,000 [1][2]; Merdeka.com, quoting the same director, reported 6,000 [4]. The 10 km was flagged off by the bank's owner and its chief executive, with Jakarta governor Pramono Anung there [1][3].

sections.heading: The Weather: Humid at Dawn, 31°C by 9am
paragraphs: Halim Perdanakusuma airport, about 11 km east-south-east of GBK, recorded 25°C at 5am on race morning, with a dew point of 23°C, 89% humidity and no wind [5]. It was the same at 6am and 26°C at 6.30am. By 8.30am it was 30°C with 66% humidity, and by 9am 31°C with 59% [5]. The airport logged no observations between 7am and 8am [5].

The programme was billed to start at 5am [6], and Sinar Harapan reported that thousands of runners had started by 6am [7]. A dew point of 23°C means sweat evaporates slowly, and the air warmed by about 5°C between 6.30am and 8.30am [5]. A half marathoner out for two and a half hours or more finishes in noticeably hotter air than they started in, so run the first half conservatively.

sections.heading: The Finish Area: A Concert and Sponsor Booths
paragraphs: After the race there was a concert by Maliq & D'essentials, DJ sets by DJ Una and DJ Berlari Berdendang, and sponsor booths handing out products [1]. Runners received a bib, a goodie bag, a jersey, a finisher medal and refreshments [6]. The bank also held a blood drive on 10 October, two days before the race [1][4].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large, lively race in central Jakarta with a party at the finish. It suits 10 km and 5 km runners, and half marathoners who are happy to run for the occasion rather than a time and can wait for the route, which the 2026 rules say will be posted on the race website [8].

Think twice if you are not an Indonesian citizen and hope to win prize money. Under the 2026 rules foreigners can enter with a passport or KITAS, but cannot win in any category; potential winners must show an original Indonesian identity card, and prize money is paid only into a Bank Victoria account in the winner's name [8]. Think twice, too, if you want a route map, past results or aid-station spacing before you commit: the race website carries 2026 information only, with the route maps still marked as to be announced [9].

The 2026 race is on Sunday 11 October from Parkir Timur GBK [8]. The half marathon starts at 5am, the 10 km at 5.30am and the 5 km at 5.45am. The start closes 10 minutes after the half-marathon flag-off and 7 minutes after the others, and the cut-offs are three and a half hours for the half, two hours for the 10 km and one and a half hours for the 5 km, counted from the gun [8]. Runners who miss the cut-off are recorded as DNF and do not get the finisher medal [8].

Entry costs Rp650,000 to Rp750,000 for the half, Rp500,000 to Rp600,000 for the 10 km and Rp400,000 to Rp500,000 for the 5 km, depending on whether you enter early, through the bank's mobile app or at the regular rate [8]. Entries cannot be refunded or transferred, race packs are collected from 2 to 4 October at Graha BIP with no delivery, and the bag drop opens at 4am and closes at 10am [8].

Half-marathon finishers inside the cut-off get a medal and a finisher tee; 10 km and 5 km finishers get a medal [8]. The rules say all three courses are measured and approved by PASI, the national athletics federation, with water stations at several points on each route and results posted on SportSplits [8]. The national half-marathon winners take Rp30 million each, and there are separate prizes for masters runners over 40 and over 50 [8].
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on Indonesian news reports on the 2025 race, the organiser's 2026 rules and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How many people run Victoria Run?
faqs.answer: About 8,000 in 2025, according to the event director, though one report quoting the same director gave 6,000. That was the race's first year at Gelora Bung Karno in central Jakarta, after two years at Q-Big BSD. It was run over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon, with a concert at the finish.

faqs.question: What time does Victoria Run start?
faqs.answer: Early. For Sunday 11 October 2026 the half marathon starts at 5am, the 10 km at 5.30am and the 5 km at 5.45am, from Parkir Timur GBK. The start closes 10 minutes after the half-marathon flag-off and 7 minutes after the others. In 2025 the programme was billed to begin at 5am.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at Victoria Run?
faqs.answer: Under the 2026 rules, three and a half hours for the half marathon, two hours for the 10 km and one and a half hours for the 5 km, all counted from the gun. Runners who have not finished by then are recorded as DNF and do not receive the finisher medal.

faqs.question: How hot is Victoria Run?
faqs.answer: Warm and humid. On race morning in 2025, Jakarta's Halim airport recorded 25°C, a dew point of 23°C and 89% humidity at 5am, with no wind. By 8.30am it was 30°C and by 9am 31°C, so half marathoners still running after 8am finish in real heat.

faqs.question: Can foreign runners win prize money at Victoria Run?
faqs.answer: No. Under the 2026 rules only Indonesian citizens can win, in every category, and potential winners must show an original Indonesian identity card. Foreigners can still enter with a passport or KITAS. Prize money is paid into a Bank Victoria account, with Rp30 million for each national half-marathon winner.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous edition (Sunday 12 October 2025). Weather is from airport METAR observations, not a forecast. The 2025 race rules, route and results could not be found: the race website now shows only 2026 information, the Internet Archive was offline, and no results page or news report names winners, so start times, cut-offs and fees are given from the 2026 rules and labelled as such. Participation is given as the organiser's 8,000, with Merdeka's 6,000 noted. Reports differ on the edition number (third or fourth), so only 'held since 2022' is used. No runner accounts were found. No rating.
